scripts.dev: npx --yes concurrently -n "backend,agent,frontend" -c "blue.bold,magenta.bold,cyan.bold" --kill-others "npm run dev --prefix backend" "bash -c 'if [ -f agent-service/.venv/Scripts/python.exe ]; then agent-service/.venv/Scripts/python.exe agent-service/app.py; elif [ -f agent-service/.venv/bin/python ]; then agent-service/.venv/bin/python agent-service/app.py; else python agent-service/app.py; fi'" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:agent: bash -c 'if [ -f agent-service/.venv/Scripts/python.exe ]; then agent-service/.venv/Scripts/python.exe agent-service/app.py; elif [ -f agent-service/.venv/bin/python ]; then agent-service/.venv/bin/python agent-service/app.py; else python agent-service/app.py; fi'
scripts.test: bash -c 'if [ -f agent-service/.venv/Scripts/python.exe ]; then agent-service/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest agent-service/tests -q; elif [ -f agent-service/.venv/bin/python ]; then agent-service/.venv/bin/python -m pytest agent-service/tests -q; else python -m pytest agent-service/tests -q; fi' && npm test --prefix backend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && bash -c 'if [ -f agent-service/.venv/Scripts/python.exe ]; then agent-service/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m compileall -q agent-service; elif [ -f agent-service/.venv/bin/python ]; then agent-service/.venv/bin/python -m compileall -q agent-service; else python -m compileall -q agent-service; fi' && npm run build --prefix frontend
